# flowmatos

> flowmatos builds AI agent pipelines that automate high-friction enterprise marketing workflows — AI search visibility (GEO), account-based website personalization, campaign brief generation, and community outreach — as an orchestration layer on top of your existing MarTech stack. No rip-and-replace. Founded by Hiren Patel, a senior AI PM and MarTech specialist with 15+ years at AWS, IBM, and Amazon.

flowmatos is a suite of four standalone products, each a focused agent pipeline rather than a monolithic platform. The core thesis: enterprise marketing teams are locked into stacks they have outgrown, while 73% of enterprise marketing sites lost traffic to AI search in 2025 and 96% of B2B visitors still see generic pages. flowmatos agents close those gaps by acting on the data where it already lives — resolving visitor-to-account identity server-side in under 50ms and measuring success by pipeline velocity, not engagement vanity metrics.

## Products

- [SignalMint](https://flowmatos.com/signalmint): Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) tool. Finds the buyer queries where ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini cite competitors instead of you, scores them by urgency, and generates CMS-ready content briefs to close each AI search gap. Live and free to try.
- [AccountLens](https://flowmatos.com/accountlens): AEM website personalization by account (ABM). Resolves every inbound visitor to a Salesforce account in under 50ms and personalizes content server-side at render time — zero JS overlay, zero content flicker. Taking design partners.
- [CampaignMint](https://flowmatos.com/campaignmint): Free AI campaign brief generator. Turns a campaign goal into a full brief in under 2 minutes — ICP, personas, messaging hierarchy, channel plan with budget weights, and KPIs. No account required.
- [ReachMint](https://flowmatos.com/reachmint): AI community outreach tool for founders and SaaS teams. Finds the communities where your audience discusses their pain points, writes authentic insight-first reply scripts, and tracks every interaction toward your goal.

## Blog — AI Search & GEO

- [llms.txt and How to Get Your Brand Cited by AI Engines](https://flowmatos.com/blog-llms-txt-ai-citations): The llms.txt standard, structured answers, and the markup that wins citations from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Mode.
- [How to Measure Your Brand's Share of Voice Across AI Engines](https://flowmatos.com/blog-geo-share-of-voice): GEO analytics — citation rate, share of voice, answer sentiment, and position-in-answer across multiple AI engines.
- [SignalMint: How to Find and Fix AI Citation Gaps for B2B Brands](https://flowmatos.com/blog-signalmint): How SignalMint surfaces the queries where AI search ignores your brand and generates content to fix it.
- [AI Brand Visibility in 2026: How Enterprise Teams Are Losing Ground](https://flowmatos.com/blog-ai-brand-visibility): Why 73% of enterprise marketing websites lost traffic to AI search in 2025 and what to do about it.
